title: Malaysian Velvety Gruyere Fritters
description: A rich and creamy take on traditional fritters, infused with the bold flavors of Malaysia. These bite-sized treats are perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the grated Gruyere cheese and velvety sauce to the bowl and mix until well combined.
4. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil, about 1 tablespoon each.
5. Fry the fritters until they are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the fritters warm and enjoy!
8. You can also store them in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
9. To reheat, simply fry them in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
10. Optional: Serve with a side of stir-fried vegetables or a simple salad for a complete meal.
